facts.fact: L'Express reports on 2026-09-03 that the new cybercrime bill, pending at the National Assembly, was to be put to the deputies' vote the next day (2026-09-04) unless the programme changed, and would create the Upin as a public establishment.
facts.system: Projet de loi sur la cybercriminalité (n°042/2026)

systems.system: Unité de protection et d'investigation numérique (Upin)
systems.owner: Public establishment with legal personality and financial autonomy (proposed under the bill)
